main_text.p: minum lemnifcatum præconem illius oculos conuerteris, ne hoc quidem magnæ sapientiæ (si qua est) videtur esse, quòd suis controuerfiis de salute atque doctrina veritatis ac fidei, quæ hoc noftro seculo in Ecclesia Christi ventilari & excuti solent, ausus est libros suos interiungere de translatione Imperii à Græcis ad Francos.

Fecerat quidem prior Illyricus, in Germanico illo Imperio degens, de ea re scriptum certa quadam occasione oblata, vt Germaniam suam, ac potius nostram, de ratione ortus & iuris totius Imperii illius informaret: atque hoc facto suo de gente Pontificiorum nonnullos excitauerat, qui acu leos illius {Greek}χρυσοπλόκῳ φωνῆς{/Greek} [?] (vt Erinna Les-bia vocabat olim) occuparent, & in arenam istam à diuino Theologiæ scammate quàm remotissimam irruerent. Nec verò plané improbare velim, si qui contra sentiunt, vt cum ratione loco suo, tempore, & modo in medium adferant sententiam suam: id enim iuris naturalis est, & à nemine honestè legiti-meque præscribi potest.
Sed quod prior seorsim fecit Illyricus, & Bellarminus quoque seorsim posteà oppugnauit, id posteà inseri in harum disputatio-

page.notes: The left strip holds only show-through from the facing page and is not transcribed. The last line is cut off at the bottom of this part and continues on the next part. Word "interiungere" and "Pontificiorum" read as printed; "Fecerat" initial F is a plain capital. The Greek words are only partly legible in the scan, so the Greek reading is uncertain. The faint fragments at the left edge are not transcribed. Long s has been normalised to s and u/v, i/j to the modern convention as instructed.
